name: hrms-monorepo
description: Production-ready HRMS Monorepo (Next.js, Express, MongoDB, TypeScript)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hrms/shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules backend/node_modules frontend/node_modules packages/*/node_modules frontend/.next backend/dist packages/*/dist
scripts.prepare: node -e "if (!process.env.CI && !process.env.VERCEL && process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') { try { require('child_process').execSync('npx husky', { stdio: 'inherit' }); } catch (e) {} }"
